proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.item
proposed_widenings.justification: The item can alter its own form, but the current activation surface has no honest way to target the held weapon itself. `alter_item_kind` exists, but there is no item/object attachment variant available to non-spell activations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Bonus Action to alter its form, turning it into a 6-inch rod ... or a 10-foot pole, or reverting it a Quarterstaff

proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.item_form
proposed_widenings.justification: Several riders apply only in named forms of the same item. Existing predicates can say only `holding_item`, not "holding this item while it is in Quarterstaff form" or "Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole forms only."
proposed_widenings.evidence: Acrobatic Assist (Quarterstaff and 10-Foot Pole Forms Only). Attack Deflection (Quarterstaff Form Only). Ranged Weapon (Quarterstaff Form Only).

proposed_widenings.name: emit_light
proposed_widenings.justification: The item has a deterministic on/off illumination state with a fixed Dim Light radius. No current surface atom or v4 atom models light emission.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause it to emit green Dim Light out to 10 feet ... or you can extinguish the light

proposed_widenings.name: weapon_property_override_with_return
proposed_widenings.justification: The item gains the Thrown property with specific ranges in one form, and after a ranged attack it immediately returns to the wielder's hand. The current surface cannot honestly express temporary weapon-property rewrites plus post-attack item return.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This weapon has the Thrown property with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 120 feet. Immediately after you make a ranged attack with the weapon, it flies back to your hand.

notes: I did not author content/*.dhall or trace files. The unit's core mechanics depend on mutable item forms and form-scoped behavior, so encoding only the generic +2 weapon bonus would be misleading.
